product_metadata.title: NOMA 7-Foot Henry Fir Christmas Tree with Lights | 400 Color-Changing Warm White & Multi-Color LED Lights with 3 Modes | 1000 Tips
features: PRE-LIT & HASSLE-FREE: Keep your holidays hassle-free with our pre-strung Henry Fir tree, which saves you both the time and effort of untangling, putting up, and taking down your Christmas tree lights every year.
3 COLOR MODES: Includes a foot peddle to easily set your preferred color mode. The 3 color modes are: alternating warm white & multi-color, warm white lights only, and multi-colour lights only.
400 ENERGY-SAVING LED BULBS: Our 400 warm white and multi-color high efficiency LED bulbs are environmentally friendly, stay cool to the touch, reduce energy usage, and will last you many seasons.

REALISTIC & STURDY: This 7-foot tree stands tall without toppling and includes a durable metal stand. 1000 PVC tips are easily spread out and give this Christmas tree a full, lifelike appearance, providing ample space for ornament hanging.

EASY TO ASSEMBLE AND STORE: Our tree is simple to assemble and disassemble and comes in three individual sections that can be attached by hand. After disassembly, please store in a cool dry place away from sunlight.
